class.name: chrono_split_ecu_bridge_hw_interface/ChronoEcuBridgeSystemInterface
class.description: Thin ROS2-topic bridge (chrono_split_msgs EcuCommand/EcuStatus) from ros2_control's command/state interfaces to a downstream ECU node (chrono_split_ecu) -- knows nothing about the FMU. Alternative to chrono_ros2_control/ChronoFmuSystemInterface's single-process design.
